paragraphs.text: translated by
1. WHERE is famed Indra heard of? With what folk is he renowned to-day as Mitra is,-
paragraphs.original: कुह श्रुत इन्द्रः कस्मिन्नद्य जने मित्रो न श्रूयते ।
paragraphs.translit: kuha śruta indraḥ kasminnadya jane mitro na śrūyate |

paragraphs.text: Who in the home of Rsis and in secret is extolled with song?
paragraphs.original: ऋषीणां वा यः क्षये गुहा वा चर्कृषे गिरा
paragraphs.translit: ṛṣīṇāṃ vā yaḥ kṣaye guhā vā carkṛṣe girā

paragraphs.text: 2. Even here is Indra famed, and among us this day the glorious Thunderer is praised,
paragraphs.original: इह श्रुत इन्द्रो अस्मे अद्य स्तवे वज्र्यृचीषमः ।
paragraphs.translit: iha śruta indro asme adya stave vajryṛcīṣamaḥ |

paragraphs.text: He who like Mitra mid the folk hath won complete and full renown.
paragraphs.original: मित्रो न यो जनेष्वा यशश्चक्रे असाम्या
paragraphs.translit: mitro na yo janeṣvā yaśaścakre asāmyā

paragraphs.text: 3. He who is Sovran Lord of great and perfect strength, exerter of heroic might,
paragraphs.original: महो यस्पतिः शवसो असाम्या महो नृम्णस्य तूतुजिः ।
paragraphs.translit: maho yaspatiḥ śavaso asāmyā maho nṛmṇasya tūtujiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Who bears the fearless thunder as a father bears his darling son.
paragraphs.original: भर्ता वज्रस्य धृष्णोः पिता पुत्रमिव प्रियम्
paragraphs.translit: bhartā vajrasya dhṛṣṇoḥ pitā putramiva priyam

paragraphs.text: 4. Harnessing to thy car, as God, two blustering Steeds Of the Wind-God, O Thunderer,
paragraphs.original: युजानो अश्वा वातस्य धुनी देवो देवस्य वज्रिवः ।
paragraphs.translit: yujāno aśvā vātasya dhunī devo devasya vajrivaḥ |

paragraphs.text: That speed along the shining path, thou making ways art glorified.
paragraphs.original: स्यन्ता पथा विरुक्मता सृजान स्तोष्यध्वनः
paragraphs.translit: syantā pathā virukmatā sṛjāna stoṣyadhvanaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Even to these dark Steeds of Wind thou of thyself hast come to ride,
paragraphs.original: त्वं त्या चिद्वातस्याश्वागा ऋज्रा त्मना वहध्यै ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ tyā cidvātasyāśvāgā ṛjrā tmanā vahadhyai |

paragraphs.text: Of which no driver may be found, none, be he God or mortal man.
paragraphs.original: ययोर्देवो न मर्त्यो यन्ता नकिर्विदाय्यः
paragraphs.translit: yayordevo na martyo yantā nakirvidāyyaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. When ye approach, men ask you, thee and Usana: Why come ye to our dwelling-place?
paragraphs.original: अध ग्मन्तोशना पृच्छते वां कदर्था न आ गृहम् ।
paragraphs.translit: adha gmantośanā pṛcchate vāṃ kadarthā na ā gṛham |

paragraphs.text: Why are ye come to mortal man from distant realms of earth and heaven?
paragraphs.original: आ जग्मथुः पराकाद्दिवश्च ग्मश्च मर्त्यम्
paragraphs.translit: ā jagmathuḥ parākāddivaśca gmaśca martyam

paragraphs.text: 7. O Indra, thou shalt speak us fair: our holy prayer is offered up.
paragraphs.original: आ न इन्द्र पृक्षसेऽस्माकं ब्रह्मोद्यतम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ā na indra pṛkṣase'smākaṃ brahmodyatam |

paragraphs.text: We pray to thee for help as thou didst strike the monster Susna dead.
paragraphs.original: तत्त्वा याचामहेऽवः शुष्णं यद्धन्नमानुषम्
paragraphs.translit: tattvā yācāmahe'vaḥ śuṣṇaṃ yaddhannamānuṣam

paragraphs.text: 8. Around us is the Dasyu, riteless, void of sense, inhuman, keeping alien laws.
paragraphs.original: अकर्मा दस्युरभि नो अमन्तुरन्यव्रतो अमानुषः ।
paragraphs.translit: akarmā dasyurabhi no amanturanyavrato amānuṣaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Baffle, thou Slayer of the foe, the weapon which this Dasa wields.
paragraphs.original: त्वं तस्यामित्रहन्वधर्दासस्य दम्भय
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ tasyāmitrahanvadhardāsasya dambhaya

paragraphs.text: 9. Hero with Heroes, thou art ours: yea, strong are they whom thou dost help.
paragraphs.original: त्वं न इन्द्र शूर शूरैरुत त्वोतासो बर्हणा ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ na indra śūra śūrairuta tvotāso barhaṇā |

paragraphs.text: In many a place are thy full gifts, and men, like vassals, sing thy praise.
paragraphs.original: पुरुत्रा ते वि पूर्तयो नवन्त क्षोणयो यथा
paragraphs.translit: purutrā te vi pūrtayo navanta kṣoṇayo yathā

paragraphs.text: 10. Urge thou these heroes on to slay the enemy, brave Thunderer! in the fight with swords.
paragraphs.original: त्वं तान्वृत्रहत्ये चोदयो नॄन्कार्पाणे शूर वज्रिवः ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ tānvṛtrahatye codayo nṝnkārpāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Even when hid among the tribes of Sages numerous as stars.
paragraphs.original: गुहा यदी कवीनां विशां नक्षत्रशवसाम्
paragraphs.translit: guhā yadī kavīnāṃ viśāṃ nakṣatraśavasām

paragraphs.text: 11. Swift come those gifts of thine whose hand is prompt to rend and burn, O Hero Thunder-armed:
paragraphs.original: मक्षू ता त इन्द्र दानाप्नस आक्षाणे शूर वज्रिवः ।
paragraphs.translit: makṣū tā ta indra dānāpnasa ākṣāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ |

paragraphs.text: As thou with thy Companions didst destroy the whole of Susna's brood.
paragraphs.original: यद्ध शुष्णस्य दम्भयो जातं विश्वं सयावभिः
paragraphs.translit: yaddha śuṣṇasya dambhayo jātaṃ viśvaṃ sayāvabhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 12. Let not thine excellent assistance come to us, O Hero Indra, profitless.
paragraphs.original: माकुध्र्यगिन्द्र शूर वस्वीरस्मे भूवन्नभिष्टयः ।
paragraphs.translit: mākudhryagindra śūra vasvīrasme bhūvannabhiṣṭayaḥ |

paragraphs.text: May we, may we enjoy the bliss of these thy favours, Thunderer!
paragraphs.original: वयंवयं त आसां सुम्ने स्याम वज्रिवः
paragraphs.translit: vayaṃvayaṃ ta āsāṃ sumne syāma vajrivaḥ

paragraphs.text: 13. May those soft impulses of thine, O Indra, be fruitful and innocent to us.
paragraphs.original: अस्मे ता त इन्द्र सन्तु सत्याहिंसन्तीरुपस्पृशः ।
paragraphs.translit: asme tā ta indra santu satyāhiṃsantīrupaspṛśaḥ |

paragraphs.text: May we know these whose treasures are like those of milch-kine, Thunderer!
paragraphs.original: विद्याम यासां भुजो धेनूनां न वज्रिवः
paragraphs.translit: vidyāma yāsāṃ bhujo dhenūnāṃ na vajrivaḥ

paragraphs.text: 14. That Earth, through power of knowing things that may be known, handless and footless yet might thrive,
paragraphs.original: अहस्ता यदपदी वर्धत क्षाः शचीभिर्वेद्यानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahastā yadapadī vardhata kṣāḥ śacībhirvedyānām |

paragraphs.text: Thou slewest, turning to the right, Susna for every living man.
paragraphs.original: शुष्णं परि प्रदक्षिणिद्विश्वायवे नि शिश्नथः
paragraphs.translit: śuṣṇaṃ pari pradakṣiṇidviśvāyave ni śiśnathaḥ

paragraphs.text: 15. Drink, drink the Soma, Hero Indra; be not withheld as thou art good, O Treasure-giver.
paragraphs.original: पिबापिबेदिन्द्र शूर सोमं मा रिषण्यो वसवान वसुः सन् ।
paragraphs.translit: pibāpibedindra śūra somaṃ mā riṣaṇyo vasavāna vasuḥ san |

paragraphs.text: Preserve the singers and our liberal princes, and make us wealthy with abundant riches.
paragraphs.original: उत त्रायस्व गृणतो मघोनो महश्च रायो रेवतस्कृधी नः
paragraphs.translit: uta trāyasva gṛṇato maghono mahaśca rāyo revataskṛdhī naḥ
